incident-bot: ALERT: Rapid increase in fallback churn + client retries for /v1/complete in region-us-east. 5xx > 20% over 90s. policy=policy-599 fallback-invocations=spike retry-score=0.89
Eli (sre-oncall): I'm oncall. Paging runtime and telemetry. What's the brief?
Lena (runtime): Router logs show repeated fallback hops for single requests. Fallback chain in policy-599 points to vicuna-13b-cpu then to redwood-vicuna-13b-quant-us-east2. The cpu variant has half the capacity of the primary.
Tom (devex): telemetry shows mobile-sdk v2.0.1 clients retrying immediately on 502 with only 100ms jitter. That's way too aggressive.
Carla Ops: Captured trace sample: ``req=lkj123 primary 502 -> fallback(vicuna-13b-cpu us-east) 503 -> fallback(us-east2) 504``. Client sent 2 retries within 800ms.
Maya (telemetry): client-segment=mobile-ios avg-retries=2.1 header=x-retry-count present in 68% of traces.
Priya (pm): Any customer impact? Any high severity tickets?
Eli (sre-oncall): One enterprise customer reported downstream 502 errors and alerted support. Creating an incident.
incident-bot: INC-2045 created and linked. Severity: P1.
Tom (devex): Immediate mitigations we can do: A) disable policy-599 rollouts B) set short-term regional QPS caps C) inject 429+Retry-After at gateway for clients D) mark vicuna-13b-cpu as not eligible for fallback. Which to prioritize?
Lena (runtime): Disable policy-599 first to stop router from switching variants mid-flight. That will stop the loop almost instantly.
Carla Ops: Running command: ``redwoodctl policy set-state --id policy-599 --state disabled --reason "fallback-loop"``
Carla Ops: Response: 200 OK. policy-599 disabled. Routers reporting change.
Maya (telemetry): Metrics: fallback count down 90% within 10s. 5xx rate dropping from 22% -> 8% in 35s. Some clients still spamming retries though.
Eli (sre-oncall): Ok next: push gateway soft-throttle for the top offending account(s). Carla, add a temporary qps cap for acct-201 and set Retry-After header for region-us-east.
Carla Ops: Executing: ``gatewayctl rate-limit --scope=account --id acct-201 --qps=30 --ttl=20m`` -> rule id rl-901. Also: ``gatewayctl set-region-retry-after --region us-east --secs 45``
Carla Ops: Rules applied.
Tom (devex): I'll notify SDK maintainers to release a patch that increases default base backoff to 500ms + jitter and max retries=3. Pushing ticket SDK-812.
sdk-bot: Ticket SDK-812 created and assigned to devex team.
Lena (runtime): Also mark vicuna-13b-cpu as fallback=false: ``redwoodctl model set-availability --model vicuna-13b-cpu --fallback-allowed=false`` -> done. Added tag no-fallback-cpu-599.
Priya (pm): Messaging for impacted customers: "We've applied mitigations: disabled a routing fallback rollout, applied temporary rate limits, and set Retry-After headers. We're investigating root cause and will follow up." I'll send to affected contacts.
Maya (telemetry): Observability note: set a temporary alert for fallback-amplification ratio > 0.5 and retries>1.5 for 5m window. Pushing alert rule now.
Carla Ops: Alert rule added: alert-id a-759.
Eli (sre-oncall): Anyone want to own the RCA/postmortem? Need timeline: when policy-599 rolled, who approved, why cpu variant was prioritized, and SDK retry defaults.
Lena (runtime): I'll take the runtime portion to verify policy generator and rollout steps. Tom, can you coordinate SDK changes and confirm client segments?
Tom (devex): On it. I'll gather SDK usage, publish emergency patch notes, and update docs.
Priya (pm): I'll draft external post-incident note after we have the RCA.
incident-bot: Mitigation summary: policy-599 disabled, model vicuna-13b-cpu removed from fallback pool, account rate-limit rl-901 applied, Retry-After for us-east set to 45s, alert a-759 added. INC-2045 status: mitigated -> P2.
Eli (sre-oncall): Handoff plan: I'll handoff to night SRE at 1791115400. Current state: traffic stabilized at ~99% success for /v1/complete in us-east, monitoring active.
Carla Ops: Handoff note: commands executed with ids: policy-599 disabled, rl-901 active, model tag no-fallback-cpu-599, alert a-759.
Maya (telemetry): Additional recommendation: add a pre-deployment check that flags fallback lists containing a model whose advertised throughput < 50% of primary. Filing RUNTIME-721.
Lena (runtime): Also adding validation to the rollout UI so policy authors see capacity mismatch warnings. Filing RUNTIME-722.
Tom (devex): Interim SDK guidance: enforce jittered exponential backoff and set sensible caps. I'll publish a small snippet in the SDK repo and notify major client teams.
Priya (pm): Customer comms: message queued. Will send once we confirm wording.
Eli (sre-oncall): Please ack once you've followed up on your action items.
sdk-bot: SDK-812 acknowledged by devex lead.
Lena (runtime): RUNTIME-721/722 created and assigned.
Tom (devex): DEVEX: I'll cut an emergency patch today.
Carla Ops: ack
Maya (telemetry): ack
Priya (pm): ack
Eli (sre-oncall): Closing live coordination. INC-2045 remains open for RCA and action tracking. Runbook note suggestion: add steps "pause fallback policy -> apply targeted rate-limits -> mark failing variant not eligible for fallback -> notify customers".
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-2045 severity downgraded to P2 after 25m of stable metrics.
Eli (sre-oncall): End of thread (for now).
